hotels.title: Chic Central Geelong Waterfront Apartment Escape near Eastern Beach
hotels.description: Settle into the heart of Geelong's vibrant waterfront precinct with a self-contained apartment stay just a five-minute stroll from Eastern Beach. Housed in a heritage-listed building, Oaks R Suites Geelong offers spacious apartments with kitchens, laundries and private balconies overlooking Corio Bay or the city - ideal for extended stays or weekend getaways on the Bellarine Peninsula. Start your mornings with breakfast at Le Café downstairs before exploring the waterfront's famous bollards or browsing the cafes and galleries along Little Malop Street, just one street over. With onsite parking and easy access to Royal Geelong Yacht Club, Steampacket Gardens and the Geelong Botanic Gardens, you're perfectly positioned to experience coastal Geelong at its best.

hotels.title: Beachfront Geelong Apartments Steps from Eastern Beach & Esplanade
hotels.description: Step straight onto Eastern Beach from Oaks Vue Suites Geelong, where beautiful beachfront apartments put you at the heart of Geelong's vibrant waterfront precinct. Wake to views across Corio Bay or the city skyline from your private balcony, with the esplanade and its famous bollards just steps from your door. Spend your days exploring the waterfront dining scene, browsing Westfield Geelong Shopping Centre five minutes away, or simply soaking up the coastal atmosphere from your self-contained apartment. With the National Wool Museum, Geelong Botanic Gardens and major event venues all within easy reach, you're perfectly positioned to experience everything this coastal city has to offer.

hotels.title: Vibrant Melbourne Southbank Escape with Glistening Swimming Pool
hotels.description: From world-renowned sporting events to graffitied laneways lined with exquisite restaurants and boutiques, to must-see art galleries and museums, Melbourne has something for everyone - and WRAP on Southbank is the perfect launchpad to unearth the city's delights. Take your pick from a stylish studio or modern apartment abode and enjoy an impeccable list of onsite facilities including a shimmering pool, undercover secure parking and a fully equipped fitness centre. While the wonders of Melbourne's lively neighbourhoods may tempt you away from your inner-city base, you can also find exceptional eateries along the Yarra River from Southgate to the Crown Entertainment Complex, maritime adventures at Polly Woodside or treat yourself to a new outfit at DFO South Wharf.
